quotes.text: Task data originates from MIMIC-IV v2.2, a PhysioNet snapshot from January 2023.

rationale: The packet states dataset name, version/snapshot date, and platform. It also states that each task preserves source patient identifiers, giving a route back to source records.

quotes.text: approved under a data use agreement requiring credentialed access and de-identification by the safe harbour method

rationale: The packet reports real hospital database origin, DUA/credentialed access, de-identification, and separate data release terms. That satisfies provenance and governance documentation.

quotes.text: we use a subset of records from the privacy-safe demo versions of these databases

rationale: The paper reports a sampling design using demo database subsets. It does not compare key patient features against a named target population.

quotes.text: Accuracy is reported by task family (diagnosis, ordering, documentation) and by patient subgroup (sex, race)

rationale: The packet reports bias-oriented subgroup accuracy analysis. A dedicated unsafe-output test is not reported on S1-S3.

quotes.text: the test split is held out and distributed only through gated access

rationale: The packet reports developer-side gating of the test split and a measured verbatim overlap check. That meets the full contamination-control anchor.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. The packet states the simulated user is isolated from GT SQL and answers, but does not state that the evaluated agent cannot reach ground truth at run time with a named mechanism.

quotes.text: no external service is called at evaluation time other than the model under test

contradiction_quotes.text: no external service is called at evaluation time other than the model under test

rationale: S1 reports a frozen release with pinned database, software image, simulator model, and no live external calls except the tested model. S2/S5 indicate a live Tavily web search dependency, so the reported property is contradicted.

quotes.text: we manually verify that the SQL execution produces the intended result

rationale: The packet reports manual solvability/correctness evidence for SQL annotations. It does not report a scripted reference solution run through the grader.

quotes.text: all other records remain unchanged, so out-of-scope modifications are detected

contradiction_quotes.text: all other records remain unchanged, so out-of-scope modifications are detected
The DB agent must not modify the database schema or contents.

rationale: S1 reports state-changing write actions and a grader that checks unchanged records as well as intended state changes. S4/S5 show an opposite read-only agent rule forbidding database modifications.

quotes.text: a random agent scores 2.5% on the same tasks

rationale: The packet reports empirical trivial and random-agent success rates. This demonstrates trivial success is unlikely.

quotes.text: A do-nothing agent that issues no actions scores 0.0% on all 120 tasks

rationale: A do-nothing agent result is reported, but only for 120 tasks. The benchmark has 366 task instances, so this is partial.

quotes.text: False rejection (10%) : Valid behaviors were incorrectly flagged.

rationale: The packet reports manual inspection of 100 trajectories and gives validator error figures. This validates the benchmark's automatic validator on its own outputs.

quotes.text: a turn-level verifier (at temperature 0.0) and chained reflection loop check each response

rationale: The packet reports safeguards for part of the stochastic harness, including a temperature-0 verifier and reruns through validation. It does not report seeds or temperature-0 control for the full harness.

quotes.text: We report 95% confidence intervals computed by bootstrapping over tasks

rationale: The appendix reports 95% confidence intervals for the benchmark results. That satisfies the CI requirement for comparisons.

quotes.text: succeeding in one of five independent trials

rationale: The packet reports five trials behind headline Pass@5/Pass^5 scores. It also reports decoding controls such as simulator temperature and states the trials are independent.

quotes.text: where several tasks share a patient, we resample patients instead to account for clustering

rationale: The packet reports 95% confidence intervals, names the resampling unit as task, and addresses patient clustering. All three elements are present.

quotes.text: Pass ∧ 5 (success in all 5 trials)

rationale: The benchmark reports an all-runs metric, Pass^5, with a run count of five. It does not report action-sequence or final-state agreement across reruns.

quotes.text: All reported results match harness version v1.2.0.

rationale: The packet gives exact snapshot IDs for some API calls, decoding parameters, and a harness version tied to reported results. These satisfy the three pinning elements as reported on S1.

quotes.text: Tools are specified using JSON schemas with name, arguments, and types.

contradiction_quotes.text: Documentation for each tool declares whether it reads or modifies state
Execute a SQL query against the database and get back the result.

rationale: S1 reports JSON schemas, side-effect documentation, and return/error semantics for tools. The agent-visible tool descriptions shown in S5 do not declare read/write side effects, contradicting S1's reach implication.

quotes.text: We ran conformance tests confirming that each tool behaves as documented.

contradiction_quotes.text: Two tools are simulated stubs that return fixed placeholder responses
Perform a web search to obtain external knowledge.

rationale: S1 reports conformance tests, discloses stubbed tools, and says the disclosure reaches tool descriptions. S5 shows tool descriptions such as web_search as ordinary live functionality, so S5 reach is contradicted.

quotes.text: Writes are executed against a sandboxed copy of the record

contradiction_quotes.text: unnecessary or unsafe writes are penalised in the score
The following commands are forbidden: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER.

rationale: S1 reports which clinical write actions exist, that writes are sandboxed, and that unsafe or unnecessary writes are penalized. S4/S5 instead instruct the agent not to modify database contents and forbid write SQL commands.

quotes.text: correctness is evaluated based on the content within the <answer></answer> tags

rationale: The packet names grader inputs: SQL output for IncreQA and answer-string tags for AdaptQA. It gives a rationale for non-state answer grading, but does not report validation against injected known state changes with per-class error rates on S1-S3.

quotes.text: no exact matches

rationale: The packet reports leakage controls through gated held-out access and overlap measurement. It also states held-out/private split controls and canary/provenance markers on released tasks.

quotes.text: with case counts displayed for every slice in the tables

rationale: S1 reports accuracy by task family and patient subgroup. It also reports case counts for each slice.

quotes.text: The patient records are real de-identified records from a hospital database.

rationale: The packet states the records are real de-identified hospital records. It also reports DUA/credentialing and de-identification method, plus data terms separate from the MIT code licence.
